Ramayana film makers warned over content before release

The Delhi Ramlila Mahasangh has issued a warning to the makers of the film 'Ramayana'. The Mahasangh has demanded a special screening of the film before its release to review its content. They have threatened to protest if controversial scenes are not removed. Separately, designers have responded to online criticism regarding the looks of characters like Sita and Kaikeyi, with one designer stating, 'See it first, then judge'. Actress Lara Dutta, portraying Kaikeyi, has also faced trolling over her look.
